contracts.name: Owner Activation Readiness Contract
contracts.ownership: Package H shared foundation under Governance Layer
contracts.lifecycle: defined in architecture; detailed in Blueprint; implemented only in a later authorized phase
contracts.validation: deterministic validator and focused tests in later phases
contracts.failure_behavior: block on missing owner, missing evidence, owner reach-in, or authority conflict
contracts.contract_stability_expectations: Blueprint may refine detail but may not redefine ownership or boundaries.

contracts.name: Neutral Integration Boundary Contract
contracts.ownership: Governance Layer referencing Master Layer Registry
contracts.validation: no duplicate registry or duplicate ownership
contracts.failure_behavior: block unregistered integration or cross-layer ownership
contracts.contract_stability_expectations: No future phase may create a parallel registry.

contracts.name: Evidence Trust Envelope Contract
contracts.lifecycle: evidence expectation now; artifact shape later
contracts.validation: evidence must be objective and reproducible
contracts.contract_stability_expectations: Future implementation may not weaken evidence requirements.
